name: 99037 · Spokane Vly, WA
findings: ZIP 99037 (Spokane Vly) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (56% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99037 (Spokane Vly) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
